configuration.additional_capture: For every one-dimensional tensor with at most 16 elements, record all values. Fix scalar row hashing by flattening before the uint8 view.

decision.pass: The c2 recurrence is unchanged and the logged packed token IDs permit deterministic alignment of the failing cache-c000 request with the R74 c1 request.
decision.fail: Any output change, nonzero cache use, or missing ID vector invalidates the localization attempt.

host_caveat: The current boot contains a pre-existing GPU reset, so localization remains diagnostic until repeated on a clean boot.
